integrity: Analytic comparison via positive compact integral operators and the known inhomogeneous-random-graph giant theorem, with reproducible symbolic and numerical cross-checks. Independent scientific validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Large-vertex limit at a fixed positive time; homogeneous Poisson vertex resets; uniform edge-attempt clocks; initially empty graph. Critical finite-size scaling, general initial graphs and non-Poisson resets are not treated. The stationary minimum-age Bessel kernel has prior coverage in arXiv:math/0504589, §16.5.
title: Exact transient percolation boundary and a strict degree-only error in a resetting network
